map.JWT 和 Session 有什么区别？: How does JWT differ from a session?
map.Session 把状态存在服务端，客户端只持有一个随机 ID；JWT 把声明（如: A session stores state on the server and the client only holds a random ID; a JWT encodes the claims (such as user ID, role and expiration) into the token itself, so the server can verify it with a key. That suits stateless, cross-service auth, but revocation relies on short expiry plus a refresh mechanism or a blacklist.
map.HS 系列是对称算法，验签需要和服务端相同的密钥，密钥绝不能暴露给前端或提交到仓: The HS family uses symmetric algorithms, so verification needs the same secret as the server, and the secret must never be exposed to the front end or committed to a repository; asymmetric algorithms such as RS/ES/PS can be verified with a public key while the private key stays on the server. This tool runs entirely in the browser and never uploads your secret; use it only for your own local debugging.
